compatibility.schema_1_0_rule: readable for diagnostics only: sessions carry only close_at, so completion semantics are unverified and the runtime must not produce library_verified, calendar_verified latest closes or a formal 5-session probability from it
compatibility.snapshot_calendar_rule: a frozen session_calendar block without completion metadata is unverified for markets with a closing-auction regime (HK: complete_at is treated as unknown and those sessions are skipped); for US the sourced no-extension rule makes close_at the completion boundary, so no offset is assumed and no metadata is required
compatibility.missing_complete_at_rule: null complete_at = unverified; the session is skipped when resolving the latest complete close. The runtime never adds an assumed offset to close_at

notes.close_at: UTC continuous-trading close instants from the pinned library; DST and half sessions are already resolved
notes.auction_end_at: latest official auction-completion boundary; null when no closing-auction regime applies or the historical boundary is unverified
notes.complete_at: earliest confirmable complete-daily-bar instant; null = unverified and skipped by the latest-complete-close resolver
notes.provenance: the digest proves content identity and the completion provenance points at the captured official sources; it is not an official full-range exchange audit
notes.phase: the sampling anchor is required to be inside the covered range; otherwise phase is unanchored
notes.target: coverage must extend at least five sessions past the newest decision date used at run time
